### Checklist

- [ ] One word per line, UTF-8, with no definitions or counts.
- [ ] The words belong to the named language and are spelled correctly.
- [ ] I searched the file for duplicates.
- [ ] TSV mappings use a real TAB between the source and result.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this data under the repository's terms.
- [ ] I did not include passwords, personal text, logs, binaries, or generated dumps with an unknown license.
